# cb:b425 · verify-drift-from-contract-in-code

> Code modules implementing contract-governed behavior detect drift from their governing contract via a verify_against_contract/0 function. Drift between what the contract specifies and what the code does is detectable mechanically; un-detectable drift is the failure mode being prevented.

**Type:** prescription · **Kind:** policy · **Domain:** system · **Status:** active
**Tags:** `contract-discipline`, `drift-detection`
**Created:** 2026-05-16

**Artifact:** `session:2026-05-16-policy-citation-sweep`

## Evidence

1. **2026-05-16** - A rule prescribed the verify-against-contract pattern but lacked an underlying policy. A separate belief covers the policy-to-contract-to-code linkage but does not specify how code detects contract drift. This policy fills that gap.
